hmmt-feb-2005-gen1-06.prompt: In an election, there are two candidates, $A$ and $B$, who each have $5$ supporters. Each supporter, independent of other supporters, has a $\frac12$ probability of voting for his or her candidate and a $\frac12$ probability of being lazy and not voting. What is the probability of a tie (which includes the case in which no one votes)?

hmmt-feb-2005-gen1-10.prompt: What is the smallest integer $x$ larger than $1$ such that $x^2$ ends in the same three digits as $x$ does?
